تشتعلي (form VIII)
# تَشْتَعِلِي (taštaʕilī) /taʃ.ta.ʕi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# تُشْتَعَلِي (tuštaʕalī) /tuʃ.ta.ʕa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
